description: Create or update catalog items by SKU (max 500 per call) — the direct seeding path for catalogs that don't arrive via import_historical_sales_orders or a channel sync, and the way to enrich existing items. Besides cost, price, barcodes and type, a row can set the built-in attributes: dimensions (length/width/height/diameter + dimensionUom), weight + weightUom, volume + volumeUom, cartonQuantity, tags, preferredLocation (bin), listPrice, shortDescription, note, taxable, salesTaxRate, isBackorderAllowed, isECommerceAvailable, replenishmentType, manufacturingLeadTimeDays, launchDate and carryingCostPerUnitPerMonth. Use these rather than creating custom fields for the same facts. Identity is the SKU within the credential's client namespace; matching is case-insensitive. Existing items are preserve-on-omit — omitted fields keep their current values; supplied upcs REPLACE the barcode list. New items default to type=inventory and the tenant's default tax/UoM; missing standard UoMs (Each/oz/lb/fl oz/in/ft) are bootstrapped automatically (reported via uomsCreated). An optional per-row imageUrl (absolute http/https, default port only) downloads and sets the item's main product image, replacing any current one; image failures are reported per-row via imageStatus and never fail the row. Image downloading for the whole call is time-budgeted: once it is spent, later rows still create/update but report imageStatus=failed — resubmit those rows in a smaller batch. Set validateOnly=true first to get every row's would_create/would_update/invalid verdict without writing — including the one tenant-level create blocker (no tax rate configured; fix it with upsert_tax_rates) — then re-call without it to apply. An optional per-row customFields map (see list_custom_fields, entity=item) writes tenant-defined field values; an unknown fieldName fails just that row. Partial success: valid rows land even when siblings fail; resubmitting is safe (the upsert converges). A client-pinned credential seeds its own client's namespace; an operator credential on a 3PL tenant passes clientId to name the target client.

clientId.description: Operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants: the target client id (GUID) the rows belong to — get ids from list_clients. Client-pinned credentials omit this; the credential decides.

items.description: Item rows to create/update (max 500). sku is required per row.

carryingCostPerUnitPerMonth.description: Flat carrying (holding) cost per on-hand unit per month, in tenant currency. Used only when run planning's carrying-cost method is per-unit. Must be >= 0. Omit to preserve.

cartonQuantity.description: Units per carton / case pack. Whole number >= 0. Omit to preserve.

customFields.description: Custom field values keyed by fieldName (see list_custom_fields, entity=item). Merged per key: omitted keys keep their value, an explicit null clears one. list fields take an option id or name; multilist an array of them. Unknown fieldNames fail the row.

diameter.description: Diameter, in dimensionUom (or the item's current dimension unit). Must be >= 0.

dimensionUom.description: Unit for length/width/height/diameter: name or abbreviation of a dimension unit from list_uoms (e.g. in, cm). Relabels the stored numbers, it does not convert them, so send the dimensions with it. Omit to preserve.

height.description: Height, in dimensionUom (or the item's current dimension unit). Must be >= 0.

isBackorderAllowed.description: Whether sales orders may be taken for this item when it is out of stock. Omit to preserve.

isECommerceAvailable.description: Whether the item is offered on e-commerce / B2B storefronts. Omit to preserve (new items default to true).

launchDate.description: When the product went live, as an ISO 8601 instant (e.g. 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z). Anchors lifecycle demand curves. Omit to preserve.

length.description: Length, in dimensionUom (or the item's current dimension unit). Must be >= 0.

lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle status: active | discontinued. Defaults to active on create; omit to preserve. A discontinued item stays sellable so its stock sells through, but nothing replenishes it: no reorder point, purchase, manufacturing or run proposal, and its demand stops driving its BOM components (components shared with active items keep those items' demand). Transfers between the tenant's own warehouses continue.

listPrice.description: List (cover / MSRP) price, distinct from the sell price. Must be >= 0. Omit to preserve.

manufacturingLeadTimeDays.description: Days to manufacture one run of this item (0-3650). Omit to preserve.

note.description: Internal note on the item. Omit to preserve; "" clears it.

preferredLocation.description: Preferred (default pick/put-away) bin: a location id, code or barcode. Receiving and fulfillment default to it. "" clears it. Omit to preserve.

replenishmentType.description: How the item is replenished: manufacture | purchase. Decides whether a reorder recommendation becomes a production order or a purchase order. Omit to preserve.

salesTaxRate.description: Sales tax rate: id, code or name from list_tax_rates. Omit to preserve (new items get the tenant default).

shortDescription.description: Short description (a one-line summary shown on lists and channels). Omit to preserve; "" clears it.

tags.description: Tags. When supplied, REPLACES the item's tag list (an empty list clears it); duplicates and blanks are dropped. Omit to preserve.

taxable.description: Whether the item is taxable on sales. Omit to preserve (new items default to false).

volume.description: Volume, in volumeUom (or the item's current volume unit). Must be >= 0.

volumeUom.description: Unit for volume: name or abbreviation of a volume unit from list_uoms (e.g. fl oz, L). Relabels, does not convert. Omit to preserve.

weight.description: Weight, in weightUom (or the item's current weight unit). Must be >= 0.

weightUom.description: Unit for weight: name or abbreviation of a weight unit from list_uoms (e.g. lb, kg). Relabels, does not convert. Omit to preserve.

width.description: Width, in dimensionUom (or the item's current dimension unit). Must be >= 0.

validateOnly.description: true = dry-run: validate + probe every row and report would_create/would_update per row, writing nothing. Recommended before the first real call.
